description: This file defines the 'DB' class within the OpenCart system, serving as a database adapter that initializes and manages database connections and queries based on provided configuration options.

classes.name: DB
classes.description: Database adapter class that manages database connection initialization, query execution, and utility methods for interacting with the database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the database connection by loading the appropriate database engine class based on provided options, and throws exceptions if required parameters are missing or if the engine class cannot be loaded.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query using the underlying database adaptor.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string to protect against SQL injection, delegated to the database adaptor.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last executed query.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID from the database.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the database connection is active.
